item.title: Job 12: Wisdom and Power Belong to God Alone
item.description: In Job 12, Job declares that wisdom and power belong to God alone. God’s sovereignty governs creation, nations, and every life.

item.title: The Ordinary Means of Grace: God’s Extraordinary Provision
item.description: God grows His people through ordinary, faithful means—His Word, the sacraments, prayer, and fellowship. This episode explains why these God-appointed rhythms anchor believers in grace, cultivate perseverance, and form Christlike maturity over time.

item.title: Eternal Conscious Torment vs. Annihilationism: A Biblical Response
item.description: In this episode of NAR to Christ, Dawn Hill is joined by David Lovi for a careful, Scripture-driven discussion on the doctrine of hell—responding to the growing conversation surrounding annihilationism (conditional immortality) and why this issue is deeply gospel-related.

item.title: The Gospel According to Eastern Orthodoxy: A Biblical Evaluation
item.description: Samuel Farag evaluates Eastern Orthodoxy’s teachings in light of Scripture, comparing key doctrines to the biblical gospel and calling believers to discernment.

item.description: In Job 13, Job trusts God even when understanding fails. This episode explores persevering faith, honest prayer, and hope rooted in God’s character.
